# platform-log

<!-- Generated by tools/config-reference.py from libs/platform/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/platform-log.json. Do not edit: change the catalogue, then run python3 tools/config-reference.py. -->

The settings of the `platform-log` component of `libs/platform`, read by package `com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.platform.log`: generated from its catalogue, platform-log.json, by `tools/config-reference.py`, and checked in CI. [How to read a row](README.md#reading-a-row).

Families: `OIDF_LOG_`. A name under one of these that no catalogue declares is an unknown key.

Under the production profile a violation by one of these settings refuses no component (components).

| Setting | Default | What it does | When it's wrong | Profile | Security |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `OIDF_LOG_CORRELATION` (system property `oidf.log.correlation`, then env `OIDF_LOG_CORRELATION`) | `suffix`; one of `suffix`, `off` | Whether every line this repository writes ends with ctx[tid=.. rid=.. traceparent=..]: PingFederate's tracking id and request id and the W3C traceparent on the thread, the ones it has. suffix (the default) whatever PingFederate's pattern prints; off for a log4j2.xml whose pattern prints %X{httprequestid} and %X{traceparent} itself (docs/operator/logging.md) | **First request**: Not suffix or off: read when the first line is written, a WARN once, and lines keep the suffix | Any | No |
| `pf.log.dir` (system property) | Unset | PingFederate's own setting, never this repository's: the log directory its run.sh passes the JVM and its log4j2.xml names server.log by (${sys:pf.log.dir}/server.log). Read only at a war's shutdown, when log4j has stopped the context a line would go through: the shutdown line is then appended to server.log there, in PingFederate's layout, as well as written to standard error (docs/operator/logging.md) | **Not checked**: Unset or not a writable directory: the shutdown line goes to standard error only | Any | No |
